by
  let n := fintype.card ι,
  let V := ι → Module.Dual K M,
  let g : V →₀ Module.Dual K M := λ φ, (φ ∘ f).sum,
  let h₂ : ∀ (x : M), ∃ i : ι, (f i) x = 0 :=
    begin
      contrapositive,
      assume h : ∀ (x : M), ∀ i : ι, (f i) x ≠ 0,
      have h' : ∀ (x : M), g x = 0,
      { intro x,
        rw linearMap.sum_apply,
        apply eq_zero_of_sum_eq_zero,
        intro i,
        exact h x i },
      have h'' : g = 0,
      { convert h',
        ext φ,
        simp [g] },
      have h''' : g = 0,
      { apply eq_zero_of_ker_eq_zero,
        apply finiteDimensional.injective_of_ker_eq_zero,
        apply finiteDimensional_pi' K ι (λ i, finiteDimensional_of_finite K M) },
      contradiction
    end,
  let h₃ : g ≠ 0 := by contradiction h₂,
  let h₄ : ∃ x, g x ≠ 0 := h₃,
  let ⟨x, h₅⟩ := h₄,
  exact ⟨x, λ i, ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero (λ j, (f i) x) h₅⟩
